messages.author: 4d78542ee90d0285
messages.subject: Problems when getting bootstrapped CI
parts:
Dear members, 


I have problems estimating bootstrapped confidence intervals, if you run the code below you'll see lavaan does not compute the bootstrapped samples, it shows the following message in each attempt: 

Computing VCOV for se = bootstrap ...  ... bootstrap draw number:    1     FAILED: creating sample statistics
  ... bootstrap draw number:    2     FAILED: creating sample statistics 



This is the code taken from lavaan webpage:

set.seed(1234)
X <- rnorm(100)
M <- 0.5*X + rnorm(100)
Y <- 0.7*M + rnorm(100)
Data <- data.frame(X = X, Y = Y, M = M)
model <- ' # direct effect
             Y ~ c*X
           # mediator
             M ~ a*X
             Y ~ b*M
           # indirect effect (a*b)
             ab := a*b
           # total effect
             total := c + (a*b)
         '
fit <- sem(model, data = Data, se = "bootstrap", bootstrap = 100,  verbose = TRUE)
summary(fit)

Do you know if there is something I'm missing? 

I'll appreciate any help.
